info.name: FawtraSmart Mobile — Clients (Node)
info.description:
Clients section of the FawtraSmart mobile backend (Node.js / Express), base `{{base_url}}/api/v1`.

Suggested order:
1) Auth → Login (stores token)
2) Clients → Client Form Options, then Add Client (stores client_id, and visit_id when a visit is opened on create)
3) Contacts & notes → Add Note (stores note_id)
4) Visit workspace → Open (stores visit_id) → Start → Step 1..4 → Complete (or Cancel)
   Use the same coordinates (24.7136, 46.6753) for the client and the visit so the proximity check passes.

Request bodies are camelCase; multipart fields use bracket notation (contacts[0][firstName], competitors[0][photo], attachments[0]).
Every request sends Accept: application/json. Responses: { success, data } / { success, message, data }; errors: { success:false, error:{ code, message, details? } }.
